title: Unabomber
plot_overview: A gifted young man’s life takes a troubling turn after he is subjected to controversial psychological experiments. Decades later, an FBI-led manhunt brings his past back into focus, tracing the consequences of ambition and isolation.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you’re drawn to true-crime stories about psychological experiments, isolation, and a decades-long manhunt; Not for you if you prefer lighter stories or want a plot with little disturbing subject matter.
review_summary: Pros: unsettling true-crime premise; themes of ambition and isolation; decades-spanning story | Cons: few details on tone; no review feedback available; potentially disturbing subject matter
